analysis: The supplied PR units contain only CHANGELOG.md documentation changes (head text); no code, configuration, or patch hunks were provided. The first changelog entry describes removal of email addresses, IPs, device serials and MDA UDIDs from coordinator logs forwarded to Datadog. This reduces exposure related to T-051/T-058 and is a privacy improvement, though the code change itself was not supplied. Other entries describe a legacy MDM frozen cohort, /v1/enroll gating, macOS 27 App Attest requirement for base rewards, and the schema migration; these relate to TB-009, TB-011, T-036 and T-052..T-058 but the implementing code is not in this batch. The changelog also states that the unauthenticated provider earnings lookup (T-031) was removed and attestation challenges fail closed. A changelog cannot create a security regression by itself. Coverage limit: implementation files are not visible, so no conclusion can be drawn about whether the described behavior is implemented correctly. Threat-model documentation gaps (for example the T-051 log-field claims or the log PII description) cannot be validated from these units. Later passes should examine the actual source changes if they exist in other batches, especially the legacy MDM cohort freeze, the enroll proof verification, the logging redaction, and the goose migrations (advisory lock and lock timeout behavior).
